h: MultiChoice introduces new DStv and GOtv packages from ₦6,000
p: MultiChoice Nigeria has restructured its DStv and GOtv bouquets, with the cheapest package starting at ₦6,000. CEO Kemi Omotosho said the change follows customer feedback.
body: MultiChoice Nigeria has unveiled new DStv and GOtv subscription packages, with prices starting from ₦6,000.

The company's chief executive, Kemi Omotosho, announced the changes in a television interview on Friday, 20 November 2026. DStv subscribers can now choose from four packages: Starter, Select, Sports and Premium. GOtv customers also have four options: Easy, Starter, Select and Sports.

Omotosho said the restructuring followed feedback from customers who wanted cheaper options and better choice, and was designed to simplify subscriptions and give viewers more flexibility in accessing entertainment and sports.
more: DStv and GOtv each have four options.
